title: Expose measurement semantics programmatically
description: Make geometry, inset, positioning, and calibration measurement controls expose units, constraints, source-versus-derived status, allowed ranges, and associated errors to assistive technology.
acceptanceCriteria: Each measurement input has a programmatic name, current value, unit, constraint/range, and instructions
Read-only derived values are distinguishable from editable source values without color
Invalid values expose field-associated reasons and allowed bounds where a real bound exists
Controls do not present prototype calibration thresholds or unsupported physical tolerance ranges

steps.details: List source and derived controls for layout geometry, safe areas, content positioning, and calibration observation entry.
Create label, unit, source/derived, constraint, help, and error metadata consumed by visible and accessible descriptions.
Apply native numeric/text patterns, described-by links, readonly semantics, and explicit unit text without ambiguous placeholder-only labels.
Query names, values, descriptions, bounds, readonly status, units, and error associations for valid and invalid fixtures.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; establish one shared pattern and representative control coverage.
Only expose ranges justified by software geometry or input representation, never invented physical tolerances.
